title: Bitcoin Hashrate Drops 4% in December, Signaling Potential Bullish Turn: VanEck
summary: Bitcoin’s hashrate fell 4% in December, a pattern VanEck says has historically preceded stronger price returns. The post Bitcoin Hashrate Drops 4% in December, Signaling Potential Bullish Turn: VanEck appeared first on Cryptonews .

title: At least 5 killed after Mexican Navy plane on medical mission crashes in Texas
summary: A small Mexican Navy plane transporting a young medical patient and seven others crashed Monday near Galveston, killing at least five people and setting off a search in waters along the Texas coast.
